company.name: Topline Pro
company.shortDescription: Topline Pro is a generative AI platform enabling home services professionals to manage and scale their businesses online.
company.description: Topline Pro delivers an AI-powered platform for home service professionals that autonomously manages marketing, sales, and operations. It offers features such as website creation, social media content, reviews, advertising, quote generation, scheduling, invoicing, and photo and customer management. The platform operates three intelligent agents, AI Marketing, AI Sales, and AI Operations, that handle web presence, lead engagement, and workflows without requiring manual intervention. Topline Pro’s approach has allowed the company to grow quickly and efficiently, supporting thousands of businesses while maintaining strong connections with the people behind them.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $27,000,000, or 61.36% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $11,180,314 to $179,794,931, a 16.08x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
